t: Magnusson 4-piece level set containing 3 box levels and a torpedo level to provide comprehensive measuring solutions, with a padded carry case for site work and installations. Constructed from lightweight extruded aluminium, these levels deliver exceptional durability whilst remaining easy to transport between jobs. The continuous magnetic base offers hands-free holding power on metal surfaces, helping to increase productivity and accuracy. Shock-resistant end caps on the 600, 1200 and 1800mm levels protect against impact damage, whilst mixed vials including 45°, 90° and 180° options handle all levelling requirements with 0.5mm accuracy.
b: Contents: 3 x box levels (600, 1200 and 1800mm), 225mm torpedo level and a padded carry case.
